messages:
eric: Heads-up — saw oscillation in routing decisions for a subset of low-latency tenants over the last 6 hours. routes flip between us-east-1 and us-west-2 every ~2-3 minutes, increasing KV cache churn and token cost.
jess: ugh. any signs it's real-time load vs metric noise? could be our latency sampling resolution.
sachi: looked at traces, spikes precede flips by ~10s. latency delta is small (~8-12ms) but our penalty score is too sensitive.
akshay: probably hysteresis too low. current policy uses instantaneous score with no decay. we should add a time-weighted moving avg and a minimum hold period.
olivia: agree. quick patch idea: add a stability_hysteresis and penalty_decay_ms. default stability_hysteresis=0.12, penalty_decay_ms=300000 (5m). that should damp churn.
eric: what about tenants on bursty workloads? longer decay could lock them to suboptimal region.
jess: true — we need adaptive windows by tenant SLA tier. e.g., tier=low -> longer decay, tier=gold -> shorter but with higher safety margin.
bot-routing: NOTE: simulated policy changes must pass integration gamma test before prod rollout.
sachi: proposal config snippet:
```
policy: {
  score_source: "latency_cost_combined",
  stability_hysteresis: 0.12,
  penalty_decay_ms: 120000,
  min_hold_ms: 60000,
  tenant_tiers: {
    gold: { penalty_decay_ms: 60000, min_hold_ms: 30000 },
    standard: { penalty_decay_ms: 120000, min_hold_ms: 60000 },
    low: { penalty_decay_ms: 300000, min_hold_ms: 180000 }
  }
}
```
akshay: also add an oscillation detector: if route flips > N times in window W, temporarily force stateful affinity for that tenant for X minutes.
olivia: sounds good. what are N/W/X? my vote: N=3, W=10m, X=15m.
eric: acceptable. we'll need telemetry: flip_count, avg_hold_time, post-fix cost delta. plumb metrics to console dashboard.
jess: I'll own a lightweight sim to validate config across our historical traces. command: `./scripts/simulate-routing --policy=tmp.yaml --trace=2026-02-10` — will run overnight.
sachi: add unit tests for hysteresis math and an integration test that asserts no flips for synthetic sinusoidal latency input.
akshay: for rollout, feature-flag the behavior by tenant group and do canary on 5% traffic then 25% then 100% with automated rollback on >5% spike in request error rate or >10% cost regression.
olivia: update runbook with steps to revert flag and kill affinity enforcement if it causes issues.
eric: timeline: jess + sachi deliver sim + tests by EOD tomorrow, akshay will prepare FF and canary. I'll update dashboard and create incident ticket if needed. thanks.
jess: noted. will post sim results in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
bot-routing: DEPLOYMENT REMINDER: create canary channel and tag with `routing-hysteresis-v1` before enabling feature flag.
